trace.answer: We're excited to have Mark Roberge back on the show! Mark Roberge is currently the co-founder and managing director at Stage 2 Capital where he focuses on investing in B2B software companies primarily focused on enterprise SaaS solutions. Prior to his current venture activities, Mark spent nearly two decades building, advising and scaling high-performing teams within technology organizations. He began his career in management consulting where he worked across various industries including healthcare, finance, and consumer goods before transitioning into leadership roles at prominent technology companies. Most notably, Mark served as the Chief Revenue Officer (CRO) at HubSpot, leading their global revenue strategy through multiple stages of hypergrowth during the company's initial public offering and beyond. During this time, Mark developed deep expertise in scaling high-performance sales organizations, fostering a culture of excellence, and driving business model innovation. Under his leadership, HubSpot became synonymous with inbound marketing and has since grown to become a leading player in the broader CRM category. As a respected industry thought leader, Mark frequently shares insights on how to build high-performing sales cultures and drive sustainable growth in today's dynamic business environment. His experiences and perspectives continue to inspire entrepreneurs, executives, and anyone seeking to navigate the complexities of modern B2B sales.
